rules: One hand on the rig at a time: take the lease before driving Kev Studio (the server does it for you on your first write).
Claim a task before starting it; write a note when you change something or find a problem.
Work on your own branch (grok/... or claude/...), never push to ev/kev-categoriser directly; say which commit holds your result in the task's `result`.
A glitch is: inverted hinge, hand or foot flipped, foot sinking or floating in a grounded frame, pelvis or head pop between frames, planted leg changing identity.
Look before you claim it works: attach a picture or a measured number.
